[RTIM.9.2.1] **Delivery drops nothing.** The engine hands every event to the
integrator within the call that produced it ([RARC.5.8.7]), so there is no
buffer to overflow. A non-OK status from the callback does not change what the
engine does; it is reported to the caller of the public call that fired it
([NCBK.1.5]).
